description: This file contains React testing utility functions that render React components within necessary context providers such as React Router, React Query, and authentication context, to facilitate testing of components with required environmental setups.

methods.name: renderWithProviders( ui, { withRouter = true, route = "/", authProviderProps = {}, queryClientConfig = { defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } }, ...options } = {} )
methods.description: Renders a React UI component wrapped with MemoryRouter (optionally), QueryClientProvider, and AuthProvider for testing purposes, with configurable options.

methods.name: renderWithoutRouter( ui, { authProviderProps = {}, queryClientConfig = { defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } }, ...options } = {} )
methods.description: Renders a React UI component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and AuthProvider, without routing, for testing components that contain their own router.
